Inspiration, Networking & Learning with leaders from top EU Companies</p><div class="Overview-module-scss-module__dJyb9a__summary"><h2>Join the Women in Tech EMEA Summit 2026!</h2><p><strong><strong>Europe’s leading conference for women shaping the future of technology, leadership, and tech business</strong></strong></p><p>The <strong><strong>Women in Tech EMEA Summit 2026</strong></strong> brings together founders, engineers, product leaders, executives, investors, policymakers, and rising talent from across Europe and beyond for a powerful two-day experience in Berlin (Venue to be Announced soon).</p><p>This is more than a conference. It is where careers accelerate, partnerships are formed, and real conversations about power, progress, and impact in tech finally happen.</p><p>Following multiple sold-out editions, the 2026 Summit will welcome <strong><strong>1,250+ attendees</strong></strong>, <strong><strong>18</strong></strong><strong><strong>+ speakers</strong></strong>, and <strong><strong>leading global companies</strong></strong> for two days of insight, inspiration, and meaningful connection.</p><h2>Why Attend?</h2><p>If you work in tech or business and care about leadership, growth, and building a more inclusive future, this summit is for you.</p><p>You will:</p><ul><li>Learn directly from senior leaders at some of the world’s most influential tech companies</li><li>Gain practical insights you can apply immediately in your role or business</li><li>Build a powerful network across engineering, product, data, AI, leadership, VC, and policy</li><li>Connect with companies actively hiring and investing in diverse talent</li><li>Be part of Europe’s largest and most influential Women in Tech community</li></ul><h2>Speakers and Companies</h2><p>The Women in Tech EMEA Summit is known for bringing <strong><strong>real decision-makers</strong></strong> to the stage.</p><h3>Speakers for 2026 Include:</h3><ul><li>Magdalena Skorupska, CMO at 42 Berlin</li><li>Monica dalla Riva, Chief Design Officer at Deutsche Telekom</li><li>Manjuri Sinha, VP HR/ Global Head of GTM Org Success & People Partners at Miro</li><li>Nikita Menon, Global Performance Manager at Delivery
